package.description: Operator CLIs for the Soul Stack config-management platform

en-US.description: Operator CLIs for the Soul Stack config-management platform
en-US.longDescription:
Soul Stack is a configuration management platform: a Keeper node renders
Destiny for the Souls it manages, over a mutually authenticated gRPC
stream, with RBAC, audit and an OpenAPI/MCP surface built in.

This package installs the cross-platform operator CLIs — soulctl (drives
Keeper), soul-lint (offline artifact linter), soul-trial (offline Destiny
and Scenario runner) and soul-legion (load generator).
en-US.name: Soul Stack
